questions.text: I feel a strong sense of belonging within the company.
Communication between employees and leadership is open and transparent.
My team collaborates effectively to achieve shared goals.
I feel valued as an employee in this organization.
I would recommend this company as a great place to work.
My work gives me a sense of purpose and accomplishment.
I receive recognition for my contributions at work.
I feel motivated to go above and beyond my regular job duties.
My workload is manageable and allows me to perform at my best.
I understand how my role contributes to the company's success.
My manager encourages and supports my professional development.
I have access to training and development opportunities to grow my career.
I am given opportunities to contribute ideas and suggestions.
I have the tools and resources needed to do my job effectively.
I believe that company policies are fair and applied consistently.
My manager provides clear direction and expectations.
Leadership demonstrates integrity and ethical behavior.
I receive constructive feedback that helps me improve.
Leaders make decisions that align with the company’s values.
I feel confident in the leadership’s ability to guide the company toward success.
